searchText: Guys these things at the very least do for bad press https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2895, the napkin computation that was made at devconnect led to 1/3, now I understand how this may have been wrong, but there is no way in hell that anyone that was not involved in the corridor discussions before this PR was up that could have possibly reviewed this. We should not have these kinds of changes being merged in the spec like this with no time for absolutely anyone to read. wen EIPs for the CL? +1 on EIPs here as a way to at least run through the motions around raising awareness to a change. I agree with your document on the topic that's why I haven't expressed opinion in that magician's topic yet. But I love the PR system in place in the CL side, just that would want to have a more open and timely manner for the community to review, like what you guys have with those discussion topics on the magician's forum We've already had the same complain when the spec freeze came before Altair I won't merge this for many days. I approved it bcause I've reviewed but I for these types of changes, I regularly leave them up for comment. I can put that in my "approve" message in the future -- e.g. "LGTM -- leaving up for review until X date" EIPs auto-merge! I hate that feature. Yeah that's very confusing, things are merged without they being final or when an author does a change to an EIP, if it passes CI, it is merged even before a co-author gets to review! More than the approval the fact that it's in the Todo of Bellatrix rc is more of a signal of a made decision, and this is not good publicity ah, I see that I meant there that'd I'd really like to have this hashed out for a bellatrix release. but I don't mean to say it is final. I welcome and extremely appreciate your review They auto-merge *if there is no status change* and the PR is by the author, I believe So usually this happens a lot when things are in Draft, and then less in Review, and we will move everything to Last Call (where there is an RSS feed people can follow) when a hard fork is scheduled. After the hard fork, EIPs move to Final, and can't be changed anymore still, as an author, I find this as a bad feature -- especially when I want my co-author to review Would prefer if author can merge without additional approval at that point rather than auto-merge But... just an annoyance, not criical its a workaround but i think you can use github's draft PR feature and the bot will leave it alone
